snippet.title: Castlevania Lords of Shadow Collection - Holiday Trailer
snippet.description:
The perfect gift for the Castlevania fan in your life has arrived! Give the gift of slick action-packed gameplay of Castlevania: Lords of Shadow (with Reverie and Resurrection DLC), Castlevania: Lords of Shadow - Mirror of Fate HD, and demo for the upcoming Castlevania: Lords of Shadow 2, all for one bundled price, available now!

Rated M for MATURE by the ESRB.

Castlevania: Lords of Shadow 2 will be available February 25th for the Xbox 360, PlayStation 3, and PC.

Developed by MercurySteam.
